verdict.rationale: GoDaddy clearly ships versioned APIs: separate v1, v2 and v3 Domains OpenAPI specs, version-prefixed endpoints such as /v3/domains, and a named v2 forwarding API. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or migration guidance between versions, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, version lifecycle or support windows, migration guides between v1/v2/v3, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: PATs are required for all v3 Domains APIs.
